spec_match.rationale: Compiles user WGSL with createShaderModule/getCompilationInfo and toggles the real 'enable subgroups;'/'enable subgroup_uniformity;' directives; the support chips now probe real surfaces — adapter feature 'subgroups' and the actual contents of navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures — instead of the previous chip that claimed subgroup_uniformity support from the unrelated 'subgroups' flag (and dead code checking a nonexistent 'subgroup-uniformity' device feature).

interactive.rationale: Presets, enable-toggles and editor rebuild work; compile requires a GPU device (see runtime_evidence).

edge_cases.rationale: No-GPU and no-adapter branches render honest chips and notices (verified here), but the compile button stays disabled in the adapter-null branch rather than offering an explanatory disabled state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified via CDP in the adapter-null environment: chips render '✗ WebGPU' and '✗ wgslLanguageFeatures subgroup entries: none' (real set enumerated), notice explains the flag/GPU requirement; the compile/getCompilationInfo path needs a WebGPU-capable browser and was not executable here.

telemetry_health.rationale: No page-level asserts; server-injected telemetry only.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select/checkboxes/textarea; chips are text with explicit ✓/✗ prefixes.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Preset select no longer forces 49px of overflow at 360px (label flex-wrap + select max-width:100%); scrollWidth 360 measured; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify compile-path behaviour with and without subgroup_uniformity on Chrome 145 hardware
openQuestions.detail: On a WebGPU-capable Chrome 145, confirm the ballot preset compiles/rejects differently as 'enable subgroup_uniformity;' toggles, and record the real driver messages; also decide what the wgslLanguageFeatures set actually lists for subgroups on 145 so the chip's honest-negative can flip to a verified positive.

openQuestions.title: Enable the compile button with an explanatory error in the adapter-null branch
openQuestions.detail: The no-navigator.gpu branch keeps the button enabled to show an honest error, but the adapter-null branch leaves it permanently disabled with no explanation on the button itself.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Smallest-fix pass: replaced the misleading subgroup_uniformity chip (it reflected the 'subgroups' adapter flag and dead code probed a nonexistent 'subgroup-uniformity' device feature) with an honest enumeration probe of navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures shown alongside the adapter chip in all branches, and fixed the 49px preset-select mobile overflow. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
